# Treanor Digital

> Treanor Digital is a Monroe, Michigan consultancy led by Kevin Treanor, specializing in AI implementation, SEO, AEO and GEO, digital marketing, and native iOS development. Backed by 20+ years across agency and enterprise digital teams.

## Core Services

- [AI Strategy & Implementation](https://treanordigital.com/services/ai-consulting/): AI opportunity and workflow audits, custom Claude and LLM internal tools, sentiment and competitive intelligence pipelines, process automation, and team enablement.
- [Digital Marketing & Brand Intelligence](https://treanordigital.com/services/digital-marketing/): Web strategy, UX, SEO, AEO, and GEO (AI search visibility), paid acquisition, email lifecycle, marketing analytics dashboards, and competitive benchmarking.
- [Native iOS App Development](https://treanordigital.com/services/ios-app-development/): Native iOS Swift and SwiftUI application engineering, StoreKit 2 purchases, offline-capable data architecture, and App Store launch delivery.
- [Web & Technology Consulting](https://treanordigital.com/services/web-technology-consulting/): Custom websites and web applications, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), marketing stack audits and integrations, LMS setup, and technical leadership.

## Engagement Models & Free Audit

- [Free Site & AI Search Report](https://treanordigital.com/seo-aeo-geo-audit/): Complimentary review of website design, messaging, technical SEO, AEO, and GEO standing delivered within five business days with zero obligation.
- [Sample Site & AI Search Report](https://treanordigital.com/seo-aeo-geo-audit/sample/): Anonymized example showing the four-pillar scorecard, AI search spot checks, and prioritized 30-day action plan included in every free report.
- [Focused Build Sprint](https://treanordigital.com/#how-we-work): Fixed-scope delivery for native apps, AI workflows, reporting dashboards, or web builds.
- [Fractional Partner](https://treanordigital.com/#how-we-work): Ongoing embedded digital and technical leadership with no long-term lock-in.

## Published Mobile Applications

- [ASE A-Series Certification Prep (iOS)](https://treanordigital.com/apps/ase-prep/): Native SwiftUI iOS study suite for automotive technicians preparing for ASE A1 through A9 certification exams, with Prometric-accurate timed mock exams, offline shop references, and StoreKit 2 one-time unlocks.
- [ASE Prep App Support & FAQ](https://treanordigital.com/apps/ase-prep/#support): Direct developer support and StoreKit purchase restoration guidance.

## Perspectives

- [Perspectives Index](https://treanordigital.com/perspectives/): Practical field notes and frameworks by Kevin Treanor.
- [The End of the Blank Prompt Box: How Duet, Dots, and Muse Change AI Adoption](https://treanordigital.com/perspectives/end-of-the-blank-prompt-box/): Analysis of how proactive personal AI assistants make agentic automation accessible to non-technical individuals, paired with practical guardrails for small businesses.
- [Two Ways Small Businesses Should Actually Use AI](https://treanordigital.com/perspectives/small-business-ai-strategy/): Strategic framework distinguishing AI augmentation of core craft from AI automation of operational overhead.

## About, Policies & Contact

- [Automotive & Enterprise Experience](https://treanordigital.com/#experience): Ten years as a developer and architect in Boston, then twenty years in Detroit automotive digital. Consulting clients include Ford (Ford Performance and Ford's aftermarket parts site), General Motors (digital marketing across its brands), La-Z-Boy and AstraZeneca. Currently Product Manager, Digital Marketing at DRiV, owning the websites for 11 aftermarket brands. Has led onshore and offshore teams of up to 30 people.
